(No 1)  3 PM
Sholes near Atlanta Ga  Washn D. C. Aug 19 1864
Grapes hunkey Imogene Kid nap Unity It seems absolutely
tartar that leopard Shld pontiac the whisky on both
banks torch ark He cannot otherwise protect the navigation
or prevent Kir - by Smith from waylaying hudson zebra
The conflict of orders at Drum probly results from the
fact that Japan first directed whinny in Wilson Adonis
to be sent to you pekin but a few days
